# Library of Congress

> > The Library of Congress is the world's largest library, providing access to millions of digitized historical documents, photographs, maps, and multimedia resources, with extensive free-to-use public domain collections and virtual tours of historic buildings like the Thomas Jefferson Building.

The Library of Congress serves as the research library of the United States Congress and houses over 173 million items. It offers digital collections, genealogy resources, reading rooms in Washington D.C., and innovative experimental projects through LC Labs, while preserving American history from the Revolutionary War to contemporary cultural heritage.

## Key Topics

- Thomas Jefferson Building
- Free-to-use public domain collections
- Digital collections and archives
- Great Hall and Main Reading Room
- Historical maps and photographs
- Genealogy resources
- Virtual tours and floor plans
- Carol M. Highsmith Archive
- Presidential portraits
- American Revolution materials
- Maritime and coastal history
- 19th-century portrait photography
- LC Labs experimental projects
- National Book Festival
- Washington D.C. cultural institutions

## Discovery and Collections

- [Discover the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/discover): Main discovery hub for catalog, digital collections, and research centers
- [Free to Use and Reuse: Presidential Portraits](https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/presidential-portraits): Free-to-use portrait collection of all U.S. presidents
- [Free to Use and Reuse: American Revolution](https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/american-revolution): Free-to-use Revolutionary War maps and founding era historical images
- [Free to Use and Reuse: Portrait Photos from the 19th-Century](https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/portrait-photos-19th-century): 25,000+ public domain portraits from C.M. Bell Studio Washington D.C.
- [Free to Use and Reuse: Genealogy](https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/genealogy): Free genealogy resources: family trees, registers, and land ownership maps
- [Free to Use and Reuse: Maritime Life and Coastal Cities](https://www.loc.gov/free-to-use/maritime-life): Free maritime and coastal city images from Prints & Photographs Division

## Virtual Tours and Architecture

- [Thomas Jefferson Building Virtual Tour](https://www.loc.gov/visit/online-tours/thomas-jefferson-building): Virtual tour of Thomas Jefferson Building murals and architecture
- [Librarian's Room](https://www.loc.gov/visit/online-tours/thomas-jefferson-building/librarians-room): Virtual tour of ceremonial Librarian's Room with decorative art
- [Northwest Pavilion](https://www.loc.gov/visit/online-tours/thomas-jefferson-building/northwest-pavilion): Virtual tour of Northwest Pavilion murals by Bela Pratt and Dodge
- [Art + Science on the Mezzanine Audio Guide](https://www.loc.gov/visit/audio-guide/art-and-science-on-the-mezzanine): Audio guide to mezzanine art, murals, and architectural features

## Visiting the Library

- [Wireless Network](https://www.loc.gov/visit/wireless): WiFi access information for Library reading rooms and public spaces
- [Thomas Jefferson Building First Floor](https://www.loc.gov/visit/maps-and-floor-plans/thomas-jefferson-building/first-floor): Thomas Jefferson Building first floor plan with reading room access
- [James Madison Memorial Building First Floor](https://www.loc.gov/visit/maps-and-floor-plans/james-madison-memorial-building/first-floor): Floor plan and navigation for James Madison Building first floor

## Innovation and Experiments

- [Experimental Access](https://www.loc.gov/labs/work/experiments/experimental-access): LC Labs experimental prototypes: Newspaper Navigator, Citizen DJ projects

## Optional Resources

- [LGBT Pride Month Audio & Video](https://www.loc.gov/lgbt-pride-month/audio-video): LGBTQ Pride month recordings featuring Eric Cervini and poetry readings
- [Jim Langevin Profile](https://www.loc.gov/disability-employment-awareness-month/people/jim-langevin): Profile of quadriplegic Congressman Jim Langevin, disability advocate
- [Reports & Budgets](https://www.loc.gov/about/reports-and-budgets): Annual reports, budgets, and congressional justifications for Library
